title: Emergency alerts
subtitle: How we tell you if a site gets hacked

push.title: Browser notifications
push.hint: The fastest channel. If you add this panel to your phone's home screen, notifications arrive just like an app's.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
push.denied: Notification permission was not granted. Without it, browser notifications cannot work.
push.noWorker: The service worker is not registered; reload the page.

readiness.none: You have no working way to be notified

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.hint: Each channel has two sides: the service must be configured on our server, and your contact details must be on file too.

phone.title: Mobile number
phone.hint: SMS helps when the phone has no internet or the app isn't installed — exactly when the other channels fail.

caveat: When an alert is sent, we only know the service accepted it — not that it reached you or was read. That is why more than one channel matters.
